name: anymotion
description: Deterministic vector animation studio for original animated sitcoms

scripts.dub:en: node dist/cli.js dub examples/pilot.json --locale en-US --translation examples/pilot.en-US.json
scripts.mux:en: node dist/cli.js mux examples/pilot.json --locale en-US --preset preview
scripts.mux:es: node dist/cli.js mux examples/pilot.json --locale es-ES --preset preview
scripts.pipeline:preview: node dist/cli.js pipeline examples/pilot.json --preset preview --translation-en examples/pilot.en-US.json
scripts.pipeline:final: node dist/cli.js pipeline examples/pilot.json --preset final --translation-en examples/pilot.en-US.json
